name: Community of St. Mary the Virgin, Wantage, The
title: Community of St. Mary the Virgin, Wantage, The
---

This sisterhood was founded by the Rev. [W. J. Butler](/person/244) in 1848. CMY became an Associate, as did many members of the Gosling Society. The community still exists and its website is http://orders.anglican.org/arcyb/csmv.html
